headline: Performance Marketing | Audience & Creative Strategy | Campaign Scaling
headline_rationale: This paid-social creative role needs research, concepts, copy, testing and commercial analysis. Use supported social channel management, audience research, design work and multichannel testing without claiming German fluency or DACH agency tenure.
summary: Performance marketer connecting audience research and creative decisions with campaign economics. Managed paid channels including Meta, Instagram and TikTok, partnered with creative and web teams, and scaled monthly marketing volume fourfold while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5. Developed marketing concepts using graphic design and animation, created search and display ad copy, and tested messaging and conversion paths. Agency experience adds client strategy, competitive research and repeatable processes for turning performance findings into clear next actions.
factual_review: Read exact Jobgether Senior Performance-Marketing Manager posting; text explicitly permits worldwide remote work. E030/E044/E037/E109/E102/E095/E076/E078/E081 support summary. No unverified German language, DACH brand portfolio or seven-figure paid-social-only spend claimed.
tools_rationale: Supported channel, commerce, analysis and AI tools for creative performance decisions.
